author: CreeperJoe62
body:
Now I've seen this on many other servers (mainly factions servers) where when your hit you cannot logout for 5 seconds and if you do your player will be left from where you logged out under the name CombatLogger .I was wondering if this plugin could be used on avicus to help stop countless complaint posts about combat loggers.

Thanks, CreeperJoe62
